definition_de: sich von allen Seiten um etwas herum aufstellen, sodass niemand entkommen kann (die Polizei umstellt das Haus); ähnlich: umzingeln
example_de: In der Nacht umstellte die Polizei das Haus, in dem sich der Bankräuber versteckte.
example_en: During the night the police surrounded the house in which the bank robber was hiding.
visual_idea: Typical news collocation 'die Polizei umstellt ein Gebäude': a lone house seen from above with police cars and officers in a full ring around it shows um- as 'all the way around'. Hunters surrounding a deer or fans around a star were less typical. The Präteritum 'umstellte' shows the inseparable form; opposite úmstellen: moving the sofa.
image_prompt: high aerial view at night of a single detached house standing alone on a dark field at the edge of a small town, police cars with flashing blue lights parked in a complete circle around the house, uniformed officers standing between the cars on all sides facing the house, one lit window in the house, spotlights pointed at the front door
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: high aerial view at night: police cars with flashing blue lights drive up from all sides and stop in a ring around a lone house, officers step out and take position around it facing the lit window; slow steady overhead camera
